anomalies.description: Document Titled '9to18.pdf' Contains Complete Commercial Inventory Spanning Floors 9 through 38: While the file is labeled '9to18.pdf' (reflecting the initial MahaRERA phase name 'ONE LODHA PLACE - FLOORS 9 TO 18'), internally it contains a comprehensive 6-page statutory disclosure detailing 224 commercial office units spanning floors 9 through 38 totaling 58,423.90 sq.m carpet area.
anomalies.significance: Provides full vertical inventory schedule for the entire 40-storey commercial tower, resolving what would otherwise appear to be an incomplete filing.

anomalies.description: Floor 13 Excluded from Commercial Unit Schedules as Statutory Refuge Floor: The unit schedule contains zero office units on the 13th floor. Municipal drawing page-2.pdf verifies that the entire 13th floor functions as a dedicated Refuge Floor providing 581.26 sq.m of refuge area.
anomalies.significance: Explains the apparent gap in commercial numbering between 12th and 14th floors and confirms statutory life-safety compliance.

anomalies.description: Phased Inventory Disclosures Reflecting Progressive Municipal OCC Approvals: MahaRERA disclosures evolved from 148 units (floors 9 to 18, June 2021) to 224 units (floors 9 to 38, October 2021) and 206 units (floors 9 to 20, March 2024). The 206 units in the March 2024 filing coincide with the floors granted Part 11 Occupancy Certificate.
